info.name: Lists all available questions, answers, and conditions.

params.name: id
params.description: List of comma separated question IDs.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale of target group in <language 1st 3 chars>_<country 2 char abbreviation> format.

params.name: translation_language
params.description: The ISO 639-2 (3-letter) code for the language to use for the `description_translated` and `text_translated` fields.

params.name: query
params.description: Text filter on the results set.

params.name: allow_custom_quals
params.description: If `true`, the response will include your account's custom qualifications in addition to the standard ones.

params.name: only_custom_quals
params.description: If `true`, the response will only include your account's custom qualifications.

params.name: end_before
params.description: Returns a list of objects that come before the provided pagination cursor. This is used for navigating to a previous page.

params.name: start_after
params.description: Returns a list of objects after the provided pagination cursor, using the next_cursor from the previous response.

params.name: page_size
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned, between 1 and 100.

items.docs:
Lists the available standard and account-specific profiling questions you can use to define your target audience. This endpoint provides the `question_id` and `option` IDs required for building the `profiling` object in other API calls, such as when creating a target group or calculating feasibility.

Key behaviors:

* **Filtering:** You can filter the list by providing a comma-separated list of question `id`s, or perform a text search across questions and answers using the `query` parameter. **
Lists all available categories for profiling questions. You can use these categories to help organize and discover relevant questions when building a target group.
